notes.content:
Found some issues post launch that players were experiencing and have fixed the following:

[list]

[*] Save data was not being read properly for docks level which is now working properly.
[*] Minor Objective issue and reward fixes.
[*] Additional info for Homing weapons added.
[/list]

notes.title: New Traversal Mechanic and the World of Cyber Seekers
notes.content:
[h2]The Glider[/h2]
While the game focuses primarily on Wall Running as a traversal mechanic to get around the world, the city offers you a new tool for faster traversal. The glider provides a unique way to explore the city from high above. Build up enough fuel by wall running and use it to enable boosters that help you stay in the air for longer. Combine this with your grapple gun, and you get a system where you never have to run on the ground again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980807/4e54fb9350967bc447a8c05ea8ad3ab48c897a8f.gif[/img]

[h2]The Story so far...[/h2]
Cyber Seekers takes place in a world where Robots have replaced human labour. The overuse of bots has raised widespread concerns regarding safety and the lack of jobs amid rising prices. Amid these concerns, some people have started using these bots to complete high-risk bounties corporations offer in exchange for credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980807/2bbe09a0bae47f32fb16fc57c17e4aa7d951e10c.gif[/img]

These people use specialized bots called Seekers to complete tasks that would rather be impossible to achieve. The game's story involves the corporation responsible for manufacturing the robots sending out a distress call requesting assistance in dealing with bots who have gone rogue.

And that sums up the basic premise of the game. More to be revealed soon.

notes.title: Demo patch notes v1.2
notes.content:
With recent playtests, players were facing issues with the tutorial level at the point where the player had to eject from the wall to complete the sequence. This sequence has been removed and replaced with another sequence.

[h1]Fixes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Schematics were not removed when an upgrade was purchased. 
[*] Reduced background music volume in tutorial level.
[*] Cosmetic changes to buttons in menus.
[*] If the bot touches the water while grappling, it no longer destroys the bot.
[*] Improved aiming and shooting in general. Resolved the issue of shooting far-off enemies inaccurately.
[*] Camera rotation when starting wall run interrupted player input for a cinematic camera; this has been changed, and the interruption no longer happens.
[/list]

[h1]Enhancements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Input icons have been added for grapple and Telekinetic Grab to make it easier for the player to perform the required actions.
[*] Traversal challenge timers have been increased for some challenges.
[*] Bots now randomly spawn ammo cores when they are shot with bullets.
[*] Increased bullet capacity of rifles.
[*] Traversal challenge checkpoint trigger size has been increased.
[*] Two new sequences were added to the tutorial. Information about alert levels is also given in the tutorial.
[/list]
